name: Versions
author: Enplace
summary: Where a project's version lives, how it's numbered, and bumping it in the code.
description: Keeps everything about a project's version in one place. It finds the file the code keeps its version in (an Xcode project or .xcconfig file, package.json, Gradle, pubspec.yaml, Cargo.toml, a VERSION file and more), or you name it, and reads the version and build number from it through a code plugin like GitHub. Set the version style, what each release bumps and where numbering starts, and Release cycle numbers its releases that way. When a release is cut, or when you press Bump, it writes the new version (and the next build number) into the file and the code plugin opens a pull request for you to merge.

settings.name: Bump the code
settings.help: Writes the new version into the file and opens a pull request for you to merge. The code plugin's token needs to write: for GitHub, Contents and Pull requests: read and write.

tools.name: get_version
tools.description: A project's version as its code says it: the version, build number and the file they're in, how releases are numbered (style, bump, next version), the next release's number, and any bump pull request in flight.
